title: Count Strictly Increasing Subarrays
goal: Count strictly increasing contiguous subarrays including single elements.
strategy: Track the increasing run ending at each index. Extend it only for a strict rise; equal or smaller values start a new length-one run. Every suffix of the current run is an increasing subarray.
